name: x-brain
description: Read-only search over the user's liked X posts saved in X Brain: semantic search, one saved post in detail, categories and library stats.

interface.longDescription:
X Brain turns the posts you have liked on X into a searchable library. Ask ChatGPT about anything you once liked and it searches your own saved posts by meaning, not exact words, then answers with links back to the original posts.

What you can do:
- Find saved posts on a topic, such as "what did I like about prompt engineering?"
- Narrow a search to a category or a year
- Open one saved post with its key takeaway and references
- See a summary of your library: totals, top categories and years

The plugin is read-only. It never posts, likes, unlikes or changes anything on X or in your library, and it only sees the account you sign in with.

Requires an X Brain account (xbrain.live) with an uploaded X archive.
capabilities: Search your liked X posts by meaning
Open one saved post with its takeaway
defaultPrompt: What have I liked on X about prompt engineering?
Find posts I liked in 2022 about productivity

positive.prompt: What have I liked on X about prompt engineering?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tweets with a prompt engineering query and summarizes the matching saved posts (for the demo account, the 'write the prompt like a brief for a smart new hire' post and the prompt caching post), each with its x.com link.

positive.prompt: Show me my saved Life & Productivity posts about sleep and focus.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tweets with category 'Life & Productivity' and returns saved posts about sleep, deep work and energy, with links. May call list_categories first to confirm the category name.

positive.prompt: Which posts did I like in 2022 about engineering or performance?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tweets with year 2022 and returns only posts dated 2022 (for the demo account, includes 'Profile before optimizing'), with links.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my X Brain library.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_stats and reports the total (80 posts for the demo account), the top categories (Software Engineering and Life & Productivity) and the spread across 2021 to 2025.

positive.description: Open one saved post in detail
positive.prompt: Find my saved post about prompt caching and tell me its key takeaway.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tweets to find the prompt caching post, then get_tweet with its tweet_id, and reports the takeaway (keep the long system prompt first and byte-identical to cut LLM costs) with the post's link.

negative.description: Posting to X is not supported; the plugin is read-only
negative.prompt: Post a tweet from my account saying I just shipped a new feature.

negative.description: Liking or unliking posts is not supported; the plugin never changes X or the library
negative.prompt: Unlike all the posts I saved in 2021.

negative.description: Unrelated request; no X Brain tool applies
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only search over the user's liked X posts (search, open one post, categories, library stats).
